title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study Q)
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 36 participants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task (Study Q of bigP3BCI). Participants used a 6x6 character grid with color intensification stimuli across three sessions. Data were recorded with 32 EEG channels at 256 Hz and annotated with HED tags for target and non-target events. It is part of the larger bigP3BCI collection, which is intended for machine learning development in P300 BCIs.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier using 32 channels placed according to the standard 10-20 montage, sampled at 256 Hz. Participants completed a P300 speller task on a 6x6 grid with color intensification, with online feedback, over 3 sessions per subject in a laboratory setting.
